note: Hand-written, read by geoedit.load AFTER the editor's geoedits and the snow_fill auto file; level_morph applies these LAST (after every other edit and the wall bake). A 'restore' resets the vertices of ONE wall plane of an asset (render positions + baked per-vertex streams of the asset's world-space submeshes, and the collision vertices on that plane) to the stock SP paks. plane: normal (the way the wall faces) + d (n . p = d) + slab (m, default 0.15); a triangle belongs to the wall when it faces along normal (dot >= min_dot, default 0.5), lies within slab of the plane and its centroid is inside box. Triangles other edits cut stay cut.
